text:
Sam: heads-up — apiserver lease queue is spiking in eu-west1 during the GPU pool scale-up. Seeing a handful of pods stuck in Terminating and controller-manager retries mounting PVs. Anyone triaging?
Anya: on it, pulling up etcd and apiserver mats now. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/apiserver-eu-west1
Lee: quick glance at apiserver logs shows a bunch of store request latencies >1s around 17:04:12
Lee: ```
I0317 17:04:12.123456 1 reststorage.go:234] etcd request took 1.24s for key=/registry/pods/namespace/foo
I0317 17:04:12.125678 1 trace.go:123] Trace[12345]: "Get /api/v1/namespaces/..." (started: 2026-03-17 17:04:10.879) (total time: 1243ms)
```
Kai: looks like kube-controller-manager is retrying mounts after nodes join. The autoscaler added 7 nodes in ~30s, lots of NodeReady + pod create events — watch fanout spiked.
Sam: that matches. Node churn -> mass pod eviction/creation -> apiserver watch + etcd pressure. We probably hit leader lease jitter too (leader-election ping spikes).
Anya: short-term mitigations: 1) throttle autoscaler burst or pause scale-up; 2) bump apiserver replicas in eu-west1 by +1; 3) increase etcd client timeout temporarily; 4) raise controller-manager leader-election lease to reduce re-elections. Tradeoffs: scaling apiserver reduces queue but costs money; changing etcd timeouts is risky.
Lee: we can flip a safer knob quickly: set --burst to 50 on kubelet/event-source to smooth event floods? Also can increase apiserver `--max-requests-inflight` for controlplane.
Kai: I can scale apiserver +1 now (manual HPA override). Want me to proceed? Might take ~2m to warm and reduce latencies.
Maria: cost note — each extra apiserver adds ~0.7 CPU and ~1GB mem on infra billing; temporary spike ok but avoid long term. Prefer config throttle + autoscaler cooldown if that stabilizes.
Sam: plan for next 15m: Kai scales apiserver +1; Anya patches autoscaler to add a 3m burst cooldown; Lee tunes controller-manager leader-election lease to 30s (from 15s) in canary; monitor etcd store latency and pod Terminating counts. If those don't improve in 10m, we'll roll back and consider increasing dedicated etcd IOPS.
Anya: I'll open a quick PR for autoscaler cooldown and post link here.
Lee: started loadwatch dashboard alert to catch repeated spikes, added runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/controlplane-throttle
Kai: scaled apiserver +1, hitting ready in ~90s. Monitoring...
Sam: seeing termination backlog drop from 42 -> 9 in last 2m. Nice. Keep an eye on etcd ops/sec and leader jitter.
Maria: :thumbsup: prefer to keep extra apiserver for 30m and then revert if stable.
Anya: PR created: https://git.internal/pulls/4823 — will deploy a canary patch for autoscaler cooldown in 5m.
Sam: thanks all — reconvene in 10 if any regressions. If stable, we'll close this thread and add follow-ups for longer-term autoscaler smoothing and prewarm strategy for gpu pools.
